events.title:
Introduction of machine learning and tools
Tool usage: iPython notebook, Google Colab
Programming: Python basics and visualization
coreOutcomes: Set up Google Colab and run basic Python code
Save and load data
Create simple plots using matplotlib
Simple data exploration and cleaning
Use AI tools (ChatGPT/Copilot) to debug code

events.title: linear regression (with a machine learning framework, input, output, loss, training)
coreOutcomes: Apply sklearn's LinearRegression to predict continuous outcomes
Explain why minimizing squared error makes sense
Understand metrics like R2, MSE, MAE, etc
Describe what the normal equation solution tells us
Compare training vs testing performance

events.title: linear regression Plus
coreOutcomes: Apply simple feature engineering
Use Ridge and Lasso regression in sklearn
Explain why Ridge regression shrinks coefficients toward zero
Describe when regularization prevents overfitting
Choose regularization strength using cross-validation
advancedOutcomes: Derive Ridge/Lasso cost functions using Lagrange multipliers

events.title: linear classification (with metrics for classifications)
coreOutcomes: Apply LogisticRegression for binary classification
Explain why we use sigmoid function for probabilities
Describe when linear classification fails
Interpret confusion matrices and classification metrics, ROC curve, AUC
advancedOutcomes: Implement logistic regression using gradient descent

events.title: Discriminative analysis
coreOutcomes: Use sklearn's LinearDiscriminantAnalysis and QuadraticDiscriminantAnalysis
Explain why LDA assumes equal covariances
Describe when LDA vs QDA is appropriate
Compare LDA vs logistic regression performance

events.title: Decision Tree
coreOutcomes: Build decision trees using sklearn's DecisionTreeClassifier
Explain how splitting criteria (Gini, entropy) work
Describe when trees overfit and how to prevent it
Interpret tree structure and feature importance
advancedOutcomes: Explore using other classification method in sklearn (eg, SVM)

events.title: Principal component analysis (PCA)
coreOutcomes: Use sklearn's PCA for dimensionality reduction
Explain why PCA finds directions of maximum variance
Describe what eigenvalues represent
Determine optimal number of components
advancedOutcomes: Implement PCA using SVD from scratch

events.title: k-means and Hierarchical Clustering
coreOutcomes: Apply K-means clustering using sklearn
Explain why K-means finds spherical clusters
Describe when hierarchical vs K-means is better
Choose optimal K using elbow method

events.title: Deep learning
coreOutcomes: Implementing neural networks using Keras
Explain why we need multiple layers
advancedOutcomes: Implement a simple neural network with different tricks: regularization, dropout, stochastic gradient descent, etc

events.title: Deep learning Convolutional network
coreOutcomes: Understand how a convolutional layer works
Implementing a CNN using Keras
advancedOutcomes: Build Convolutional neural networks using Keras
Describe what convolutions detect in images
Load pre-built CNN (eg, vgg-16) or other architecture to a classification problem
